answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 54 aliases, and each one needs its own funded spiral account. Deposits are visible in fable, and vertex reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 60 aliases cost 276 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
